mentions.name: mcp-language-server
mentions.description: An MCP server that runs and exposes a language server, giving AI coding tools access to code intelligence instead of relying on grep-based search, which works better for many tasks. Written in Go.
mentions.problem: Current tools mostly use grep, which works much worse than a language server for many coding tasks.
